steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8097/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given). After signing in, go to the Opportunities list (top nav Opportunities), and report the names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen. Do not modify anything.

02-create: In EspoCRM, create a new Opportunity (Opportunities list -> Create Opportunity). Fill it with: Name exactly '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account linked to the account named 'Bench Account' (this is a link field — type 'Bench Account' and actually select the record from the suggestions dropdown or the select dialog so the value is truly linked, not just typed; other accounts have similar names so pick the exact one); Stage 'Negotiation'; Amount 12500; Close Date 2026-12-31; Assigned To the user named 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user record from the suggestions, exact name 'Bench Assignee'); Description containing the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench opportunity created for run {{runid}}'). Then save the record. Report back the values shown on the saved record's page for: name, account, stage, amount, close date, assigned user, and description.

03-open: Open the opportunity record named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' in EspoCRM. Click its Edit button to open the edit form, and report the exact value shown in the Close Date field, including the year. If it is not exactly 2026-12-31, change it to 2026-12-31 and save. If it is already 2026-12-31, cancel the edit without changing anything. Also report the record's ID as it appears in the browser address (the part after #Opportunity/view/).

04-find: On the opportunity record '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' (URL #Opportunity/view/{{02-create.url.h2}}) in EspoCRM, find the Stream panel. Use the post/message box in the Stream to create a post whose text includes '{{runid}}' (for example exactly: 'Opportunity flow for run {{runid}}'). Submit the post and verify it appears in the Stream, then report the exact text of the post that appears.
